review_context.scope: Fresh source/artifact review only; no project imports, NN calls or remote execution.

summary: No concrete blocking defect found in the four recorded sources for the declared RGBNT201 bounded native3-per-mode diagnostic. Both controls retain the original E28 five-module private encoder, common-coordinate public25 setup and shared training step; the only paired outlet intervention is PM/PF P(x) versus x+P(x). Real Adam updates, per-parameter finite/nonzero gradients, independent Adam replay, all7 native private invariance and same-instance strict four-state reload are required by the code. Actual success remains unobserved. This PASS covers the bounded diagnostic and its collection, not formal50, all49 or a scientific gain claim.

evidence: rgbnt201_projection_probe.py:46-81 verifies RGBNT201/demo/seed42, COMPLETE50, best epoch28, descriptor5120, 2647 updates, zero skips/holdout, classes/cameras, native exit0 and the full official split manifest before loading best.pth.
The inspected local original receipt independently records classes171, cameras4, 3951/836/836, best28 and those completion facts. The local manifest has 171 train identities and 30 test identities.

Every original state key must exist with identical shape/dtype; only the exact 18 declared new top-level prefixes are accepted. The merged state loads strictly, and every loaded original tensor is compared exactly. No R201A/B or MSVR expert/public weights are transplanted.

The adapter freezes BACKBONE/rgb_reduce/nir_reduce/tir_reduce/generalFusion and its train override resets all five to eval after every model.train call. The existing assert_anchor_unchanged checks both mode/requires_grad and exact saved parameter/buffer values after construction, every update and reload.

The native fixture compares both initial full-RNT private5120 tensors exactly with a separately constructed original DeMo loaded strictly from the same checkpoint. The full-availability FP32 fusion wrapper still calls the same original GeneralFusion; original inference does not use the trainable classifier/neck heads.

Before updates, all seven availability-aware private outputs are saved on query[:8]; both modes agree exactly. After each mode completes three updates, all seven outputs must still equal those saved references. This is an 8-image fixture across seven sets, not all836 missing-view descriptor comparison.

After the full836 readout the six private metrics must equal the archived original full_metrics within 1e-8. Missing availability is the shared encoder skip/zero/mask path, not original DeMo forwarding zero images through its backbone.

EvidenceBypass wraps the existing Sequential children without creating parameters or changing numeric child keys; it only returns input plus the same projection. PM and PF are replaced together; PI is unchanged.

Both modes use the same CommonCoordinateAxis fuse: normalized projected directions, unchanged relation weights, residual_scale, gates and public-tail insertion. Neither mode changes FFT masks, expert/router layout, standalone auxiliary taps or public25 metric.

Each variant resets seed42 before construction, uses identical constructor order and checkpoint overwrite, and asserts exact equality of all initial state tensors across its two modes. The wrappers consume no RNG. frequency_shared and axis_shared instantiate the same parameter modules; their constructor difference is the intended structured/frequency flags, not parameter creation or initialization.

The launcher compares parameter/trainable counts and batch names between variants. Cross-variant initial tensor equality is a source-level conclusion from the identical seeded constructors, not an executed cross-process tensor comparison.
The probe calls run_shared_identity_experiment.step directly. It does not enter the M4/M6/M8 wrappers or R201B ranked objective.

The inherited full loss weights for DIRECT=1 are [1,.1,.1,1,.25,1] over fused, independent M, independent F, original MoE, shared and original global outputs. Existing contribution calibration weight .05 remains. Each ID/triplet pair uses the existing RGBNT201 CE weight .25 and triplet weight1.

Partial training uses the existing .25 label-smoothed CE plus .5 partial-query/full-gallery triplet with the detached current full11 gallery. The three updates use retained R, N and T in that order. No loss, sampler, auxiliary tap, routing factor or PI change is introduced.

make_optimizer visits every requires_grad model parameter and excludes the frozen five modules and existing frozen BN biases. The probe requires torch.optim.Adam and copies each initial parameter plus exact optimizer group/default settings into an independent replay optimizer.

Shared step performs full forward/backward, releases full activations, performs partial forward/backward, unscales, executes GradScaler.step and updates the scale. Native GradScaler starts512, and each reported update must retain scale512 with optimizer_updated true.

After each real step every optimized parameter must have a finite nonzero gradient. Those unscaled accumulated gradients are assigned to the replay parameters, replay.step is executed and each live/replay parameter is compared at rtol1e-6/atol1e-7. Gradients are overwritten each iteration; a replay zero_grad call is unnecessary.

The original five-module BN/dropout path stays eval and is checked exactly. New and original trainable head BNs remain in normal training mode. Reseeding immediately before each loader gives matched original B64/P8/K8 batches; names are compared across both modes and variants.

After three updates, eval forward returns the inherited four states00/10/01/11 on the native fixture. state_dict is serialized to BytesIO and loaded with strict=True, then all four descriptors must compare torch.equal and the frozen anchor check runs again.

States10/01 use the existing independent m0/f0 pools, their own calibrator calls and separate fuse branches; state11 uses conditioned routed evidence. CommonCoordinateAxis changes only the common outlet and keeps these state semantics.
This is strict serialization/reload in the same constructed instance. It is not an independently rebuilt-model load, optimizer-resume test or all49 state evaluation.

SharedIdentityAxis.forward computes conditions, m1/f1, router.route and then full fuse before controlled_states. Therefore the first PM/PF forward-hook calls in readout are the actual full11 routed tensors Bx7x512 and Bx512, respectively.

The hook keeps only that first call. Calling nn.Sequential.forward directly computes P(x) using the exact existing children without recursively invoking the outer hook; the projection contains LayerNorm/Linear/GELU/Linear and no running-state or dropout layer. Eval readout runs under no_grad and outside autocast, consistent with CommonCoordinateAxis FP32 projection.

It asserts the returned live output equals P(x) or x+P(x), then records input, narrow and bypass readouts from that identical x. M retrieval features are the mean over seven routed relations; geometry uses the unpooled relations. The four deployed states and separate private descriptor are also recorded.

full_records uses all official train_171 records and the two full official test lists, remaps only train labels, requires disjoint train/test identities and never invokes split_records. The probe asserts 3951/836/836. Only three training batches per mode are consumed by this bounded diagnostic; full training coverage is not claimed.
Evaluation concatenates query+gallery in the same B64 deterministic eval loader layout as the original full-official evaluator, normalizes features, then separates the exact official lists.

full_metrics receives true query/gallery IDs and cameras, excludes same-ID/same-camera junk, writes each query row, calculates AP/INP/CMC and cross-checks the existing evaluate_reid implementation. Models are not used as retrieval ground truth; original metric equality is a separate parity assertion.

The six outlet descriptors additionally report centered normalized-query singular-value numerical rank and squared-singular-value entropy effective rank. These are empirical representation statistics, not evidence of a proven causal rank64 bottleneck.

The local deployer addresses only host2026 and the established project/conda/data/pretrained/original-training anchor paths. The anchor path includes training/RGBNT201_demo_s42. Only the three new runtime sources are copied; the reviewed local deployer is included in the four-source acceptance map.

The launcher has exactly two lanes: frequency_shared on physical2 and axis_shared on physical3. The existing executor asserts GPUs2/3, waits240 seconds on occupied memory and exports CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. It contains no temperature or power query/condition.

The source-review gate checks PASS/no blockers, all four current source digests and the selected parent digests on the remote project before launch. No source is changed by this review. Directly reused digests include both runtime sources and the two existing local deployment helpers, following the existing project convention.

The deployer waits its one original SSH/controller process, inventories and copies the produced JSON/CSV/log evidence even after a nonzero diagnostic exit, and records exit status before requiring success. No retry/restart loop or formal50 command is present.

Every NPZ is copied through existing copy_verified into its own D-drive archive and verified by size/SHA. Only after controller exit0, terminal COMPLETE, 12 total updates, four NPZ and no new weights does it recheck and unlink those same four remote raw files. Text receipts and original weights are not cleanup targets.

interpretation_limits: SOURCE_ONLY PASS: native updates, zero skips, all-active gradients, Adam replay, original parity and strict reload have not been executed by this reviewer and are not yet observed results.

New experts and the fresh trainable shared/public head are common setup. The .75 private/.25 public metric remains; fused00/full11 are not promised equal to strong original DeMo. Only private5120 is protected.

The readout occurs after three updates per mode and covers normal full-RNT query/gallery only. The broader design note also suggested pre-update m0/f0/m1/f1 captures and partial-query GT readouts; those are not implemented or claimed by this narrower task.

The exact all7 descriptor invariance and four-state reload checks use the 8-image fixture. Full836 normal private checks compare six scalar metrics; the code does not compare every full836 private tensor/per-query result with a new original-model extraction.

Each mode reports x/P(x)/x+P(x) from its own actual routed tensor. After separate optimization, the two models have different learned states; their readout differences cannot be described as a same-trained-state intervention across modes.
Both M and F bypasses form the single joint PM/PF interface factor. Their separate causal contributions are not isolated. PI, upstream rank64 attention, routing and fixed public25 remain.

This supplies at most a bounded feasibility/evidence diagnostic, not full50, all49, useful learned expertise, a dataset-wide bottleneck, unique dual-axis gain, multiple-seed evidence or scientific acceptance.
Requested model/backend/effort are recorded separately from actual UNATTESTED runtime identity. The review is fresh-context same-family and provisional, not cross-family acceptance.
